author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt: YOUR PIECE (Elixir tooling + docs, no translator changes): a readiness harness ... run it over the real projects ... write docs/readiness.md ... Add elixir elixir/readiness.exs elixir/src to check.sh

title: Readiness harness: elixir/readiness.exs walks any .ex module (GenServer or receive loop) against an allowlist of translator-supported forms and reports every unsupported construct with file:line; aggregated over loom, ensemble, blinks_backend, big_bill, bobs_broadcast into docs/readiness.md; self-check on elixir/src in check.sh
